extra.comment: EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL is read from the environment at build/start time. See src/config.ts.
extra.squarePaymentsNote: squareApplicationId is the PUBLIC Square sandbox APPLICATION ID — it is NOT a secret and is safe to ship in the app bundle (it only identifies the merchant app to Square's In-App Payments SDK so cards tokenize on-device). The privileged SQUARE_ACCESS_TOKEN stays backend-only (hard rule #1). When going live, swap this to the production application id (sq0idp-...) and set squareEnvironment to 'production'. Read by src/payments/squarePayments.ts; full runbook: docs/EAS_AND_PAYMENTS.md.
